prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a cinematic high-fashion half-length portrait of an adult woman with a dreamy editorial vibe. Use multi-exposure blur for one ghosted duplicate and vertical light streaks. Set against a blue gradient background from #0033A0 to #66CCFF; the subject wears an oversized white T-shirt. Apply high-contrast lighting with a cool blue wash and coral-orange edge highlights for a futuristic glow. Her expression is neutral and introspective, with softly lit eyes. Simulate a 50-85mm lens at f/1.8 with shallow depth of field. Enhance with motion blur and chromatic separation while keeping central facial details sharp. Aim for a surreal digital-youth mood blending minimalism and light play.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, text, logo
